_Description: Phenotype dictionary of catDCM2BIDS for a common coding of the phenotypic data tables of different studies. Columns whose (normalized) name is one of the Variants are renamed to the field name (e.g. gender -> sex), and their values that are one of the Variants (or the Code or Description) of a level are replaced by its Code (e.g. weiblich -> F). Names and values are compared in lower case without spaces and special characters (e.g. 'Research Group' = researchgroup, 'ADNI 4' = adni4). Numbers are never recoded by the dictionary (e.g. 1 is male in one study and female in another), but by the coding of each table: the description of the header (e.g. 'SEX (male = 1, female = 2)') or the Levels of the JSON sidecar of the table (e.g. table.json of table.csv). Other values are kept (with a warning). Copy and extend this file for your studies (field Phenotype dictionary of the batch).
